2.0: His people also worshipped the sky: the stars, the moon, the sun. So Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, showed them, step by step, why none of these could be a god.

3.6: And Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: "Peace be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me."

4.0: Words had not moved them. So Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, made a plan.
4.3: On a festival day, the whole town left. The temple stood empty. And Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, went in alone.

6.1: He was a man so proud of his kingdom that he argued with Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, about his Lord.
6.2: Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: my Lord is the One who gives life and causes death.
6.4: So Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: "Indeed, Allah brings up the sun from the east, so bring it up from the west."

7.1: Only a few believed in him. Among them was his nephew, Lut, alayhis salaam.
7.2: So Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, left the land of his birth, with nothing but his faith.

8.0: His son Ismail, alayhis salaam, was born. And then came a test that no father would choose.
8.1: By Allah's command, Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, brought the baby and his mother to a dry valley, with no water, no plants, and no people. The valley of Makkah.
8.3: And Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, turned to the sky and prayed: "Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, that they may establish prayer."

9.0: Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, had seen the fire turn cool. He had seen water rise from a desert. And still, he asked his Lord for one more thing.

10.0: Years passed. Ismail, alayhis salaam, grew into a boy who could walk and work beside his father.
10.1: Then Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, saw a dream. And the dreams of prophets are revelation.
10.4: When they had both submitted, and Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, laid him down on his forehead...

11.0: Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, was now an old man. And his wife, Sarah, had never had a child.
11.2: Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, was known for his generosity. Without a word, he went to his family, and came back with a fat roasted calf.
11.5: His wife, who was standing nearby, smiled. And they gave her the good news of a son, Ishaq, and after Ishaq, Yaqub, alayhimus salaam.
11.7: From Ismail, alayhis salaam, would come the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. From Ishaq, alayhis salaam, would come Yaqub, Yusuf, Musa, Dawud, Sulaiman and Isa, alayhimus salaam. The father of the prophets.

12.0: Then Allah showed Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, the place of His House. And father and son began to build.
12.1: Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, laid the stones. Ismail, alayhis salaam, carried them. And as the walls of the Kaaba rose, they prayed:
12.4: And they asked for one more thing: our Lord, send among them a messenger from themselves, who will recite Your verses to them. Thousands of years later, that dua was answered: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.
12.6: And they still come. Millions of people every year, answering the call of Ibrahim, alayhis salaam.

13.0: In his old age, Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, stood in the valley that had once been empty, and he made a dua that Muslims still recite today.
13.5: Many of us say this dua in every prayer, at the end of our salah. The words of Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, still on our tongues, thousands of years later.
